title: Stochastic Geometrically Exact Beams: Continuous-Time Geometric Principles and Variational Discretizations
summary: Geometrically exact beams naturally arise in physical phenomena and engineering practice for modeling flexible structures, such as soft robotic manipulators and DNA structures. To the best of our knowledge, there appear to be no geometric integrators for stochastic geometrically exact beams in a variational formulation. In this paper, we introduce variational principles for the dynamics of stochastic geometrically exact beams, in both continuous- and discrete-time settings.
